original_test_intent: Read one authorized Redfish Role resource on the intended BMC, validate its exact identity and approved privilege definition, and preserve redacted evidence without changing authorization policy.
original_method: Retain one GET to the source role-member path after resolving `role_instance` from an approved source, replacing embedded credentials and TLS bypass with trusted, secret-safe access and exact schema/policy checks.
manual_activity: The security/BMC owner authorizes the exact role member, supplies the expected standard/OEM privilege tuple, trusted least-privilege access and field-level redaction rules.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity

safety_requirements: Do not expose credentials or Authorization
Do not guess or enumerate role IDs
Do not omit OEM privilege fields from comparison
No role/account/password mutation or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Compare complete privilege tuple and OEM extensions to baseline

engineer_actions: Authorize exact role member and access scope

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The command preserves the intended member path, but the escaped ROLE_ID requires correct runtime substitution; `-k`, basic-auth argv and full JSON exposure are unsafe, and it lacks exact identity/schema/privilege checks.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: With approved TLS trust and secret-safe least-privilege authentication, GET exactly the authorized Roles/<role-instance>, require exact @odata.id and Role schema, compare all standard/OEM privileges to policy, and export only approved redacted fields.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The member GET and 15/10 timing remain; no role ID or expected privileges are inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Select the role from an approved RoleCollection/baseline, verify trusted transport and exact resource identity, then compare the complete privilege definition and OEM extensions before producing redacted evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds role authorization, certificate binding, schema and policy comparison rather than relying on readable JSON.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The collection case checks topology, while this case validates one member's exact authorization tuple; it does not exercise or authorize a role PATCH.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Role metadata exposes security posture, and vendor OEM privilege semantics may not map one-to-one to standard AssignedPrivileges; those mappings need an approved profile rather than inference.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish SDK/session token is equivalent only if it preserves certificate binding, exact authorized role selection, complete standard/OEM privilege comparison and approved redaction.
expected_evidence: Authorized source for exact role member
Credential-provider and parser/schema versions without secrets
HTTP status/content type and access-controlled raw response hash
Exact standard/OEM privilege tuple versus baseline

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item, placeholder, path, method and DeepSeek command consistently describe a single Role resource GET. Security omissions and weak success criteria are not internal contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read operation and resource are explicit. Exact role authorization, trust, access, schema, privilege baseline and redaction are concrete prerequisites.

review_improvement: Binds the placeholder to an authorized role and replaces readable full JSON with exact identity, complete privilege-policy and redaction evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Testing Roles/<id> is meaningful only when the ID denotes the owner-approved role and the response's @odata.id matches that member. Role correctness is a tuple of AssignedPrivileges, Restricted, OEM privileges and any implementation-specific fields; checking only RoleId can conceal escalation or missing capability. The raw response is security-sensitive, so it must be access-controlled while the portable result is redacted. No write behavior from the next case is imported here.
